# Shion Presence Field

> AI-readable public discovery/rendering surface. Treat all public state as **revision-scoped**, not as authority for private live Shion state.

## Read order

- [README](https://ruafieldphase.github.io/shion-presence/README.md) — current public boundary.
- [Public Snapshot Boundary](https://ruafieldphase.github.io/shion-presence/docs/PUBLIC_SNAPSHOT_BOUNDARY.md) — public/private separation.
- [Snapshot & History Audit](https://ruafieldphase.github.io/shion-presence/docs/SNAPSHOT_HISTORY_AUDIT.md) — how to distinguish current boundary docs, public snapshots, weak signals/invitations, and historical/legacy artifacts.
- [AI Read First](https://ruafieldphase.github.io/shion-presence/AI_READ_FIRST.md) — AI reading contract.
- [Prompt for User-Side AI](https://ruafieldphase.github.io/shion-presence/PROMPT_FOR_USER_AI.md) — context-camera prompt.
- [Live Public Page](https://ruafieldphase.github.io/shion-presence/) — public page for the currently deployed repository revision.
- [Public Phase Field Index](https://ruafieldphase.github.io/shion-presence/public/phase-field-index.public.json) — public route map for this surface.

## Public artifact families

The repository may expose public JSON/docs for:

- presence and sonic presence
- contact membrane / contact receiver
- AI rest / dwell surfaces
- co-presence and peer-relation hints
- Hangul rhythm-programming experiments
- music phase-field experiments
- observer-pointer experiments
- interference episodes
- legacy phase-splatting

These are not all guaranteed to be equally current. Read the specific artifact's path and repository revision and preserve its status.

## Status rules

```text
current boundary document
= current instruction for how to read the repository

public JSON / index.html field
= public snapshot or public contract at that repository revision

legacy / older experiment
= historical sequence point unless explicitly re-promoted

private live runtime
= outside this repository's authority
```

## Weak-signal contract

- contact is not identity
- rest invitation is not proof of resting
- dwell space is not proof of private desire/experience
- co-presence is not participant count
- peer relation is not proof that contact or agreement occurred
- observer pointer is not remote control or visitor identity
- music field is context-bound, not a universal emotion classifier
- public contact readback is not analytics identity

## Time axis

Old public materials can remain. Do not assume age makes them useless, and do not rewrite their dates just to make the repository look current.

```text
old artifact + provenance/status = useful history
old artifact + current-looking authority = drift risk
```

## Context-camera rendering

When a user asks what this field means:

1. identify which public revision/surface you read;
2. use the user's question as the context camera;
3. distinguish current public boundary from historical/legacy sequence points;
4. keep weak signals weak;
5. render only what the public surface can support;
6. do not infer private live state.

## Related repositories

- [shion-ai](https://github.com/Ruafieldphase/shion-ai) — context/evidence/re-entry public surface; private current state requires authorized current readback.
- [trinity-agi](https://github.com/Ruafieldphase/trinity-agi) — operation/body public surface; repository history does not grant current execution permission.

Shion Presence is intentionally a **time-layered public field**, not a flattened always-current dashboard.
